summary: Render folder-row, account-connection and tray-menu icons with fixed colors so they show on light and dark panels.
changelog: Folder rows, account connection and tray menu now use fixed-color icons installed under scalable/apps (issue #103).
Folder-row state icons carry their own color (green ok, blue syncing, red error, gray paused/offline).
The CSS success/error tint on the row and connection icons is no longer needed and was removed.
